name: crush-lang
description: Syntax highlighting and diagnostics for the Crush language

crush.crushcPath.description: Path to the crushc binary used for diagnostics. Defaults to whatever 'crushc' resolves to on PATH.

crush.diagnostics.enable.description: Run crushc on save/change and show its diagnostics as problems. Only used as a fallback when the crush-lsp language server isn't available — see crush.languageServer.enable.

crush.diagnostics.onChange.description: Re-run crushc-fallback diagnostics on every edit, not just on save. Irrelevant when the language server is active — it already gets live document sync.

crush.languageServer.enable.description: Use crush-lsp for diagnostics, hover, and completions if it's found on PATH. Falls back to spawning crushc directly (crush.diagnostics.*) when it isn't.

crush.languageServer.path.description: Path to the crush-lsp binary. Defaults to whatever 'crush-lsp' resolves to on PATH.
